privacyPolicyPage.privacyPolicyPage_nos_termos_da_lgpd_voc: Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD), you may ask us to confirm whether we process your data and request access or corrections. Where the law provides for it, you may also request anonymization, blocking or deletion, data portability, and information about whom we shared your data with.
privacyPolicyPage.privacyPolicyPage_para_exercer_esses_dir: You may ask whether you can decline consent and what happens if you do, withdraw your consent, and request deletion of data processed on that basis, subject to legal exceptions. Where applicable, you may object to processing that violates the LGPD and ask for a review of decisions made solely by automated means that affect your interests. You may also file a petition with Brazil's data protection authority (ANPD). To exercise your rights, send a request through the contact channel listed in this policy. We may ask for information needed to verify your identity.

privacy.description: We use essential technologies to keep you signed in, protect access, and make ProdForge work. With your permission, we use analytics to understand how people use the site and improve the product. The marketing setting saves your preference. You can change your choice in Privacy Preferences.
